title: Site clearance & setting out
headline: The building is pegged out on the ground. Mistakes here are built into everything after.
seoTitle: Site clearance and setting out a house in Nigeria: what to check
seoDescription: How site clearing and setting out work on Nigerian building sites, the common mistakes, and the photos to request as proof from abroad.
summary: Clearing removes vegetation and topsoil; setting out marks exactly where every wall will go using profiles (boards and strings).
duration: 2–7 days for a typical bungalow or duplex plot [CHECK for large or sloping plots]
whatHappens: Site clearing: bush, roots and topsoil are removed from the building area; the site is levelled roughly.
Site facilities: a storage shed for cement, water supply (often a borehole or tanker), security and a gateman.
Setting out: using the site plan, the builder fixes the building’s position from the beacons and boundary, respecting the approved setbacks.
Profiles: timber boards on pegs around the building with nails and strings marking wall centre-lines and trench edges.
Checking square: diagonals of each rectangle are measured — if they match, the corners are square (the 3-4-5 rule).
Levels: a reference level (benchmark) is fixed so floor and foundation levels can be controlled.
problems: Building placed too close to the boundary or over the setback line, risking a fight with neighbours or development control.
Corners not square — rooms end up out of shape and roofing becomes difficult.
Building rotated or shifted from the approved site plan.
Paying for ‘clearing’ that was barely done, or for removing the same soil twice.
No proper store: cement left in the rain and spoilt.
questions: How far is the building from each boundary, and does it match the approved site plan?
Have you checked the diagonals? What were the measurements?
Where is the benchmark/reference level, and what is the finished floor level relative to the road?
Where will materials be stored and how is the site secured?
photoCheckpoints: Wide photo of the cleared site from each corner.
Photos of the profiles and strings with a tape measure showing boundary distances.
Video of the diagonal check with both tape readings visible.
Photo of the material store and water source.
